records.name: Homeowner Protection Office
records.establishedMeaning: established by section 3 of the Homeowner Protection Act, in force that day (OIC 1188/1998, B.C. Reg. 309/98); it opened on 1 October 1998

responsible.locator: OIC 1146/1998, approved 16 September 1998: administration of the Act assigned to the Minister of Municipal Affairs
responsible.note: Ends with that ministry; who answered for the office from 2001 is not in this research.

records.description: Provincial office created in 1998, after the leaky-condo crisis, to license residential builders, protect buyers of new homes and run the Reconstruction Program of loans to owners of failed buildings. On 1 April 2010 it was folded into others: licensing, owner-builder authorization, research and education went to BC Housing, and the Reconstruction Program to the Ministry of Finance.

names.name: Provincial Rental Housing Corporation
names.locator: Printed p. 42, middle column near bottom, No. 52129; PDF p. 14.

records.description: The Province's holding company for social and low-cost rental housing. One corporation throughout (BC0052129): incorporated privately as Pemco Holdings Ltd. in 1961, acquired by the Province in 1973, and renamed twice in 1976. BC Housing administers it, came to control it through board-appointment changes on 26 January 2024, and consolidated it in its accounts from 31 March 2024. No share transfer is shown, and administration is not ownership.
